title: issue-tracker-adapter-contract
description: Abstract CLI contract that every issue-tracker provider adapter (e.g. issue-tracker-linear, issue-tracker-github) must satisfy. Consumers of typed-agents-core's issue-driven-flow protocol invoke these verbs via a binary named 'issue-tracker' on PATH. Adapters live outside this repo (one per provider) and are composed by the consumer alongside typed-agents.

binary_name.description: All adapters expose the same binary name. The consumer's PATH resolves to whichever adapter is installed.

config_file.description: Adapters read this file from the consumer repo root (walking up from cwd). Schema at https://raw.githubusercontent.com/viblocks/issue-tracker-linear/main/schemas/issue-tracker-config.schema.json (or sibling repos for other providers).

verbs.description: Required and optional verbs. Adapters MAY exit with code 3 and a 'not supported' message for optional verbs.

description.const: Search issues. Adapters pass through provider-specific flags.
Create an issue. Labels must already exist provider-side.
Move issue to 'work in progress' state. Provider-side state name comes from adapter's state-mapping.
Move issue to 'done' state, attaching the evidence file as a comment. Errors if --evidence is missing.
Append a comment without changing state.
Move to 'done' without evidence. Use for stale/duplicate/won't-fix. The evidence-gate hook will block this verb if used in a change-flow context where evidence is required.
Move to 'cancelled' state. Optional; adapters may exit 3 if provider has no cancel state.
Print the configured issue ID prefix (e.g. 'VI'). Used by audit-trail hooks to derive the trailer regex without hardcoding.
Print a regex that matches valid issue IDs (e.g. 'VI-[0-9]+'). Used by hooks and CI gates.
Run provider-side preflight: validate auth, team/project existence, labels, workflow states. Exit 0 if all checks pass, 1 if recoverable, 2 if fatal.

known_adapters.description: Informational list of adapter repos known to implement this contract.
